# RLSOK Local Check 1.5.12 for Windows

This self-contained ZIP is for Windows 10/11 x64. Extract it to a new directory, open `START-HERE.html`, then run the included example or `Start setup assistant.cmd`. It requires no account, separate Node installation or robot for the example.

The local assistant now reads an expanded URDF and selected controller configuration, suggests recognizable model/controller/joint names, connects them to discovered interfaces and exports a reusable checked workspace. It preserves the existing adapters and saved-file workflows. Units, frames, physical meaning and active-controller identity still require explicit review. There is no AI service, cloud upload or robot-command endpoint.

The ZIP's version and source were checked after extraction on Windows, and its setup assistant started locally. See the [1.5.12 changes and limits](https://github.com/realitywarden/rlsok/blob/v1.5.12/docs/releases/v1.5.12.md). This check does not establish private-interface compatibility, physical robot use or customer acceptance.
